title: Critical Voltages Expression
description: Essential: Correctly states V1 = sqrt(R1 α (Tc - T0)) and V2 = sqrt(R2 α (Tc - T0)).

title: Temperature Ratio Derivation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the ratio (T_max - T0)/(T_min - T0) = R2^2 / R1^2.

title: Oscillation Period Calculation
description: Essential: Derives and simplifies the period to approximately 0.68 L/R1 under given conditions V=sqrt(V1V2) and R2=16R1.

title: Power Balance Application
description: Important: Applies thermal equilibrium condition V^2/R = α(T - T0) to find critical currents and temperatures.

title: Sketch and Qualitative Description
description: Important: Provides a correct qualitative sketch of T(t) showing sawtooth-like oscillations between T_min and T_max.

title: LR Circuit Dynamics
description: Important: Uses exponential current relaxation I(t) = V/R + (I_initial - V/R)exp(-Rt/L) for each resistance phase.

title: Phase Transition Conditions
description: Important: Identifies correct transition currents I1 = sqrt(α(Tc-T0)/R1) and I2 = sqrt(α(Tc-T0)/R2).

title: Sign or Unit Error
description: Pitfall: Confuses R1 and R2 in formulas for V1/V2 or temperature ratio, or omits square roots.

title: Algebraic Simplification Error
description: Pitfall: Makes errors in simplifying the period expression after substituting given numerical conditions.
